nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole privilege check for delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Whitelisted trading address that is allowed to bypass the sale condition checks in ensure().
Mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition checks in ensure().
Mapping counting how many sales each address has performed; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Maximum number of sales allowed per address; set in init and read in condition().
Minimum sale amount in token units; set in init and read in condition().
Maximum sale amount in token units; set in init and read in condition().
Public balance mapping mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Total token supply, minted to owner in the payable constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address used in the ensure() whitelist comparison.
Constant 18 decimals used to scale supply/min/max sale values.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source address.
Public payable transfer entry point: spends allowance, calls ensure/condition, mutates balances and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal whitelist gate: returns true for owner/tradeAddress/UNI/pair/canSale callers, otherwise delegates the check to condition().
Internal sale policy check reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum[_from].
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only delegatecall proxy function; executes arbitrary calldata at an arbitrary address in this contract's storage context.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using raw multiplication by 10**decimals.
Owner-only batch transfer; computes total with unchecked multiplication and mutates balances without SafeMath in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist.
Pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of the sorted token pair and init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name/symbol/supply, assigning owner = msg.sender and pre-approving the UNI router for uint(-1).
Caller-controlled address used for authentication in delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress and as transfer source in transfer/transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication 'uint total = _value * _tos.length' in batchSend, vulnerable to integer overflow.
delegatecall to an arbitrary address and arbitrary bytes supplied by the caller, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' and 'balanceOf[_to] += _value' in transferFrom (no SafeMath).
Unchecked 'allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value' in transferFrom (no SafeMath, pre-checked by require only).
Unchecked balance mutations in the batchSend loop: 'balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total' and 'balanceOf[_to] += _value'.
Recipient parameter _to of transfer().
Amount parameter _value of transfer().
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom().
Recipient parameter _to of transferFrom().
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom().
Spender parameter _spender of approve().
Allowance amount parameter _value of approve().
Target address parameter a of delegate(), forwarded to delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata parameter b of delegate(), forwarded to delegatecall.
saleNum parameter of init(), written into _saleNum.
token parameter of init(), scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init(), scaled into _maxSale.
Array parameter _tos of batchSend(); its length feeds the unchecked total multiplication.
Per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend().
addr parameter of setTradeAddress(), written into tradeAddress.
Local 'uint total' in batchSend computed from unchecked multiplication.
Loop counter i in batchSend.
Local loop recipient _to in batchSend.
Local _UNI pair address computed by pairFor() inside ensure().

edges.reason: transfer() forwards the untrusted msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom().
transferFrom() branches on msg.sender != _from to decide whether an allowance must be spent.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
delegate() gate 'require(msg.sender == owner)' depends on caller-controlled msg.sender.
init() gate 'require(msg.sender == owner)' depends on caller-controlled msg.sender.
batchSend() gate 'require(msg.sender == owner)' depends on caller-controlled msg.sender.
setTradeAddress() gate 'require(msg.sender == owner)' depends on caller-controlled msg.sender.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privilege root.
transfer() reads its _to parameter and passes it to transferFrom().
transfer() reads its _value parameter and passes it to transferFrom().
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() invokes ensure(_from, _to, _value) as a gate.
ensure() falls back to condition(_from, _value) when the caller is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure() reads owner to short-circuit the whitelist check.
ensure() reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass for _from.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
ensure() stores the pairFor() result into the local _UNI used in the whitelist comparison.
transferFrom() performs the unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
The _from parameter indexes the balance mapping mutated by unchecked arithmetic.
The _value parameter is added/subtracted from balances without SafeMath.
balanceOf is read to validate and then updated by the unchecked arithmetic operation.
The unchecked arithmetic writes the new balances back into balanceOf.
transferFrom() decrements the spender allowance with plain subtraction.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and then decremented by the unchecked operation.
The _value parameter is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] to track the sender's sale count for the policy checks.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sales cap.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _minSale to bound the transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the transfer amount.
init() writes the caller-supplied saleNum into _saleNum, reconfiguring the sale policy.
init() writes the scaled token value into _minSale.
init() writes the scaled maxToken value into _maxSale.
init() reads the constant decimals to scale the min/max sale values.
The saleNum parameter flows into the _saleNum state write in init().
The token parameter flows into the _minSale computation in init().
The maxToken parameter flows into the _maxSale computation in init().
delegate() is the sole entry point that reaches the arbitrary delegatecall.
The caller-supplied address a is used directly as the delegatecall target.
The caller-supplied bytes b is executed verbatim as delegatecall calldata.
The delegatecall executes external code in this contract's storage context, which can re-enter this contract's state-mutating functions mid-execution.
batchSend() performs the unchecked 'uint total = _value * _tos.length' multiplication.
The _value parameter is a multiplicand in the overflow-prone total computation.
The array length of _tos is the second multiplicand in the overflow-prone total computation.
The unchecked product is stored in the local total.
batchSend() mutates balances inside the loop without SafeMath.
The unchecked total is subtracted from the sender balance.
The loop recipient's balance is increased by the unchecked _value.
The _value parameter is added to each recipient balance without SafeMath.
batchSend() reads each element of _tos into the local _to.
The loop counter i indexes the _tos array to select _to.
batchSend() drives the loop counter i over the recipient array.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
The _spender parameter flows into the allowance mapping key in approve().
The _value parameter flows into the allowance write in approve().
setTradeAddress() writes the caller-supplied addr into the tradeAddress whitelist.
The addr parameter flows into the tradeAddress state write.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, granting full privileged control to the deployer.
Constructor mints totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router address.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply scaled by decimals.
transferFrom() reads balanceOf[_from] to enforce that the transfer does not exceed the balance.
transferFrom() reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] to enforce the spender allowance.
delegate() authorizes execution using the owner state variable.
init() authorizes execution using the owner state variable.
batchSend() authorizes execution using the owner state variable.
setTradeAddress() authorizes execution using the owner state variable.
The constructor initializes the owner state variable that all privilege checks depend on.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter is local to transfer(); it is consumed only by that core function before being forwarded to transferFrom.
The _value parameter is local to transfer() and defines the amount forwarded to transferFrom.
The _from parameter is used only inside transferFrom() for allowance, ensure and balance arithmetic.
The _to parameter is used only inside transferFrom() as the receiving balance key.
The _value parameter is used only inside transferFrom() for allowance and balance arithmetic.
The _spender parameter is used only as the allowance mapping key in approve().
The _value parameter is used only as the allowance amount written in approve().
The target address parameter a is used only inside delegate() to pick the delegatecall target.
The calldata parameter b is used only inside delegate() as the delegatecall payload.
The saleNum parameter is used only inside init() to configure the sales cap.
The token parameter is used only inside init() to derive _minSale.
The maxToken parameter is used only inside init() to derive _maxSale.
The _tos array parameter is used only inside batchSend() for the total computation and loop.
The _value parameter is used only inside batchSend() for the total computation and per-recipient credits.
The addr parameter is used only inside setTradeAddress() to set the whitelist address.
The local total stores the unchecked multiplication result, so it collapses into the overflow unsafe operation.
The loop counter i exists only within batchSend() and carries no independent semantics.
The loop recipient _to is only the balance key for the unchecked credit inside batchSend().
The local _UNI pair address is used only within ensure() for the whitelist comparison.
